mapper.select: select b.id, b.book_name as bookName, b.cover_url as coverUrl, a.author_name as authorName, b.category_id as categoryId, b.update_status as updateStatus, b.book_intro as bookIntro, b.word_count as wordCount, b.latest_chapter_id as latestChapterId, b.latest_chapter_name as latestChapterName from book_info as b left join author_info a on b.author_id = a.id where b.category_id = #{categoryId}
